verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm offering legal services, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-authored automations is a category error for this kind of product. Its client-facing tech (trademark extranet, AI review tools, Fenwick Labs document generation) consists of firm-operated tools, not a platform where users build and manage their own automations. Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined automation workflows that could be versioned or rolled back.
